text:
Han Xiao raised his eyebrows and said, "What's wrong with that? My Credibility Points have already met the requirements. My Credibility Points have already met. "

。”

Martin said with disdain. "I want warriors and bodyguards. Your resumes are all about the daily missions in Juberly Hub. You're just a bunch of janitors. Are you really mercenaries?"

Han Xiao frowned and said, "What do you mean?"

"What I mean is that you don't meet my recruitment requirements." Martin waved his hand impatiently. Although he was very stingy and did not want to pay a high salary, it did not affect his picky appetite. He wanted to pick the best out of the worst, so he spent the least amount of money to hire the mercenaries with the highest value ratio. This had always been the nature of the Neran people — stingy and greedy. Although the average strength of the Black Star Mercenary was grade C, this resume made him doubt their actual combat ability. If he recruited unreliable mercenaries, they would not be of any use when the expedition team was in danger.

The surrounding mercenaries all started to mock Martin and support him.

"It's only 400 Enas, and you're still being so picky."

"Haven't you heard that you get what you pay for?"

"Heh, Neran people."

Han Xiao was annoyed. Sigh, why are these mercenaries joining in the fun? Why do I feel like they are not helping me at all? Instead, they are adding insult to injury.

Martin rolled his eyes and took the opportunity to lower the price. He pretended to be in a difficult position and said, "With your resumes, I can only offer 200 Enas per person."

"Goodbye."

Han Xiao turned around and left. He was too lazy to argue with Martin. Martin's attitude made him very unhappy. It was never Han Technician's style to be bullied by others. He did not want to earn this extra income. There were so many opportunities anyway, and he did not want to waste his life on a crooked tree. Han Xiao opened the mercenary interface and found the application list of the Sunil Race. There were a few missions, all related to the same incident.

The Sunil Race's homeland was destroyed by Dark-star, and with the help of Godora, they moved to another forest planet with dense natural energy and changed the name to Planet Sunil.

Planet Sunil had a large number of native beasts, and most of the time, they were very tame. However, the underground of Planet Sunil contained ores with the 'nature' of mind pollution. Every few years, all the beasts on the planet would enter an inexplicable manic period, causing the new home of the Sunil Race to suffer. Every time this happened, the Sunil warriors would return to their home to protect their homeland and recruit a large number of mercenaries to help them.

This was a very pitiful race. They were originally just a planet-level civilization, standing aloof from worldly affairs and working hard to develop. However, they were suddenly attacked by DarkStar and met with a calamity. They did not even have the strength to fight back. DarkStar's battleships bombarded the ground, and countless cities were bombarded by lasers and missiles, turning into fireworks that soared into the sky, swallowing the screams and cries. Even despair fell into the void. It was a one-sided massacre.

Dark-star and Godora were mortal enemies, and they were very active in the Garton Star System. Dark-star took advantage of Godora's weakness as a member of the lawful faction and attacked the planets under Godora's jurisdiction time and time again, forcing Godora to help the low-level civilizations that were in trouble, thus exhausting Godora's resources. If Godora did not help, their jurisdiction over the Garton Star System would not be stable.

Dark-star belonged to the evil faction, and attacking low-level civilizations had long violated the 'Universal Contact Treaty'. However, the Shattered Star Ring was a borderland, and every time they completed a mission, Dark-star would disappear for a long time, avoiding the attacks of other civilizations. They were like a terrifying shadow that always covered the Garton Star System.

When Godora's fleet arrived through hyperdrive, the surface of the Sunil mother planet had already become a scorched earth with lava flowing everywhere. The ecosystem had collapsed, and only less than ten percent of the people survived, being protected by Godora. The technology of the survivors had been cut off, and they had not recovered all their technology even now. The refugees were settled on Planet Sunil, and even the city that they were living in was built with the help of Godora. After settling down for a few years, they discovered the situation with the wild beasts.

At this time, it would be very troublesome to migrate again. Godora had helped them the last time out of humanitarianism, and if they asked Godora for help again, many Sunils would feel that this meant that their race had completely become dependent on Godora, and they would not be able to accept it psychologically. Thus, they stuck to their current situation and resisted the wild beasts, barely surviving.

It was the time of the wild beasts recently, and the goal of these few missions was to recruit people to protect their home. However, the danger of the missions increased with each level. The most dangerous mission did not even have anyone applying, and the easiest mission required 120 Credits.

Mercenary Mission: Protect Forest City

Mission Introduction: The Sunil race has encountered a new round of 'Catastrophe'. You have accepted the mission, and your duty is to protect Forest City.

Mission Requirements: Protect Forest City.

Failure Condition: Forest City is lost.

Failure Penalty: -60 Credibility Points

Reward: 500,000 EXP, 1,800 Enas, + 34 Credits, + 3 Area Renown

Mission Start Time: 12 days later

The Sunil race called the wild beasts' Catastrophe ', and Forest City was the current main city of the Sunil race.

This was just a normal mission, and it was not Han Xiao's entire goal. He accepted the mission so that he could have a reasonable identity to contact the Sunil race. Sunil's storyline mission had to be triggered by himself.

As one of the members, the players also received the mission of the mercenary group. Han Xiao also released a faction mission that rewarded faction Contribution Points upon completion of the mission. It seemed like a double reward, and the players felt like they had earned something.

This was the Black Star Mercenary's first combat mission, and everyone was eager to give it a try.

Han Xiao waved his hand.

"Let's go."

…

Three days later, the group took a direct flight and arrived at Planet Sunil. From the perspective of the universe, this was a green forest planet surrounded by white clouds.

The tremor came suddenly, and the spaceship entered the atmosphere. The surface of the planet gradually enlarged in their field of vision. The spaceship followed the route, and the sea of trees receded in their field of vision. Han Xiao looked out from the porthole, and a plain appeared in the middle of the forest. A city stood on the plain. This was the new home of the Sunil race, Forest City.

The spaceship lowered the airdrop cabin, and Han Xiao and the others felt a slight sense of weightlessness. Then, the ground shook, and they landed steadily.

Chi!

The cabin door slid open, and outside was a continuous military base. Han Xiao stepped out of the cabin door and saw teams of Sunil soldiers wearing heavy individual armor patrolling and standing guard.

Sunil Defensive Soldier Armor, as the name suggested, was the individual combat armor worn by the Sunil soldiers with the quality of a normal person. It was silver-gray in color, and the armor plate was extremely thick and could block rapid fire from cannons. After wearing it, the person would feel like they had expanded a few times. The soldier armor weighed close to a ton, and it had its own power unit. It was equipped with large caliber depleted uranium defense machine guns, shoulder rocket launchers, melee combat wrist saws, and so on.

The Sunil race was a pure technological civilization, and when a technological civilization developed to a certain point, they would definitely branch out into individual armor. Different technological civilizations had their own armor styles. The individual armor of the Sunil race was divided into Enlistee Class, NCO Class, Defense Class, Assault Class, Reconnaissance Class, and so on.

In fact, Han Xiao knew that the Sunil race had an even more powerful 'General Class' armor. However, with the destruction of their homeland, the manufacturing technology had been lost.

Other than the armor technology, there were also mechanical weapons, vehicles, and a few small galactic-level battleships parked in the distance.

Looking at the dazzling array of machines, Han Xiao felt extremely satisfied and excited. Civilizations that leaned toward technology were the best 'breeding ground' for the Mechanic class. This was also the reason why he had tried so hard to get in touch with the Sunil Race. The Sunil Race's machinery level just so happened to be able to provide him with a lot of help. There were too many benefits.

The Sunil subclass that Han Xiao had his eyes on was related to machinery. It was a rare subclass that could be linked to his main class! For Han Xiao, this was one of the best choices for completing the Class Advancement.

The players were amazed by this scene. Han Xiao had introduced the sad history of the Sunil race on the spaceship. They had originally thought that a fallen civilization would be very sad and backward, but they had not expected to see such an awe-inspiring scene.

Thump, thump, thump.

Heavy metal footsteps sounded, and an armored warrior approached. His armor was obviously better than a normal soldier's, and it was painted with a war totem that was a mixture of red and white. This was an Officer Class armor. The approaching Sunil was obviously an officer. His face was as cold as stone, and he had the aura of a soldier.
